newsitem.title: FINLAND: RESEARCH ALERT-RAUMA STILL OUTPERFORMER AT GOLDMAN.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-RAUMA STILL OUTPERFORMER AT GOLDMAN.

text.p: Goldman Sachs has reiterated its market outperformer stance on Finnish engineering group Rauma after the group's first half earnings report last week, analyst Hakan Ostling said on Monday.

The investment bank had raised its earnings per share forecasts for the group by five percent for each of the forecasting periods, he said but declined to give the forecasts or state a price target for Rauma shares.
Ostling said Rauma was an opportunity to get indirect exposure to the pulp and paper industry's upswing.
Rauma closed flat on Monday at 122.50 markka.
